d:
Vinod Joshi and his wife Meena Joshi are living happily with their son Mithu in Alibaugh. One day Vinod returns home covered with blood and tells Meena that there was a murder of an employee, Kale at his workplace. A large amount of money was stolen. The police are called in to investigate, and as a result a fellow-employee, by the name of Subramaniam is arrested and sentenced to jail. But then things turn and Vinod finds himself in trouble. Watch the movie.
YOR – 1976
Star Cast - Vinod Khanna, Shabana Azmi, Utpal Dutt, Bindu, Durga Khote
Director – Vikas Desai, Aruna Raje
Producer – N B Kamat
